copy.headline: Halter mini in the house leopard print — shoulder rosette, asymmetric ruffle hem.
copy.description: A plunging halter neckline, an oversized rosette at the shoulder, and a cascading asymmetric ruffle hem that moves with every step. Cut in the Finaluchi house leopard on a cream ground, the Rossa is photographed across the size range because it is made for every version of her.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs. Rosettes are cut and mounted by hand.
copy.editorialQuote: One print, one rosette, one dress — endlessly worn.

fabric.drapeDescription: Fluid body-skimming drape with lift at the ruffle hem
fabric.finish: Matte print on a cream ground with black and mauve spots
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
